title: Carolingian Chronicles: Royal Frankish Annals and Nithard's Histories
author: Anonymous (compilers of the Royal Frankish Annals)

_quarry.citation: Scholz, Bernhard Walter, trans. Carolingian Chronicles: Royal Frankish Annals and Nithard's Histories. Ann Arbor: University of Michigan Press, 1972.
_quarry.notes: Latin Frankish royal annals covering 741–829, compiled in stages at the Carolingian court. The Scholz translation pairs the Annales regni Francorum with Nithard's Histories (covering 814–843) — together the closest the Carolingian dynasty has to a continuous narrative record.
